name: duct
description: Find out before you launch why Google won't index your site, why a shared link previews blank, why ChatGPT can't read it and whether your signups are tracked. Checks the live pages and the code behind them, scores the launch out of 100 and gives three ranked fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Is your site ready to launch?
interface.longDescription: Ask "is my site ready to launch?" and Codex reads your live pages and the repository behind them. It finds why Google won't index a page, why a shared link previews blank, why ChatGPT and Perplexity can't read the site, and whether the signup button sends an event. It also checks what the page promises against what the code does. You get a score out of 100, three fixes ranked by impact and effort, each as a diff applied only when you say yes, and a 1200x630 card to post. No account, no key; nothing is sent anywhere except the site being checked.
capabilities: Check a live site before launch
Check page claims against the code
Draw a score card to post
defaultPrompt: Is my site ready to launch?
Check my site before I post it on Product Hunt
